name: moto-travel-planner
title_zh: 国道加油站间距先算，再排每天骑到哪的摩旅路书
tagline_zh: 汽车导航给你的路线，摩托不一定敢走：它按 ADV 续航、国道风景和日落时间倒推每天落脚点，连哪段没加油站都标出来。
tagline_en: Car nav routes a bike can't ride. It works backward from ADV range, scenic highways and sunset to set each day's.
desc_en: Use when the user says mtp/MTP、摩旅、路书、骑摩托、摩托车行程、骑行路线、国道骑行、ADV 出行，或要求规划、调整摩托车旅行路线；不用于订票付款、医疗建议、四轮城市游或 SMTP/HTTP 协议问题。
why_zh: 先算续航与补给点，再谈风景；落脚点由日落和体力倒推，不是按城市均分里程。
why_en: Range and fuel stops come before scenery; daily stops are derived from sunset and rider fatigue, not evenly split mileage.
limit_zh: 只管路线与路书，不订票不付款；不覆盖四轮城市游、医疗建议和 SMTP/HTTP 协议问题。要你提供车型续航。
limit_en: Routes and roadbooks only: no booking, no payment, no car city trips, medical advice or SMTP/HTTP issues. Needs your bike's range, start point and.
title_en: Motorcycle Tour Planner That Checks Gas Gaps First
